_source: Copied from README.md tables (Results, Baselines, Seeds, Quantization) on 2026-09-28. Regenerate by hand if the README changes; every number here must match it.
claim: A 1.01M-parameter CNN trained from scratch matches ImageNet-pretrained detectors 4–20× larger on StyleGAN2-vs-FFHQ detection, at the lowest GPU latency of the four, measured on the identical task, same GPU, same session.

headline.name: test19_sg2_crop_no_fft
headline.architecture: five 3×3 conv blocks (32-64-128-256-256), each followed by max-pooling; global average pooling; Dense 128; Dropout 0.4; sigmoid. No FFT branch, no batch norm, no pretraining.
headline.input: a 256×256 window of native pixels from a 1024×256 face; nothing is resized

story.text: Reals were 512², fakes 1024². The model read the resolution, not the face. Found by auditing file properties. A shortcut, discarded.
Both classes 1024² from official sources, shrunk to the model's input. The resize deletes the generator fingerprint: after it no pixel property separates the classes (high-frequency AUC 0.52).
Same model, same input size, same latency; the 256² is a window of untouched pixels. Verified not a new shortcut: native audit 0.55, JPEG q95 costs 0.001, unseen reals scored correctly.

comparison.note: One L4 session, fp32, batch 1, median of 1,000. CPU = TFLite/XNNPACK fp32 (12 threads); the earlier TensorFlow-CPU column mis-ranked depthwise models and was withdrawn. Baselines are ImageNet-pretrained and fine-tuned on the identical crop pipeline.

seeds.note: Same recipe, three random seeds (sample, split, initialisation, shuffle). Test AUC.

quantization.note: Post-training TFLite conversion, one Xeon session, 12 threads, XNNPACK. int8 weights = dynamic range; int8 full = weights + activations, calibrated on 200 test images. Baselines scored on 2,000 test images.
quantization.reading: Post-training int8 works on plain 3×3 convolutions (this model: 4× smaller, 2.9× faster, accuracy unchanged; Xception fine) and collapses the mobile architectures to chance — hard-swish and squeeze-excite need quantization-aware retraining. On CPU at fp32, MobileNet is the faster model; this model is the fastest one that survives post-training int8.

negatives.result: buys 0 on the mix, +0.011 on resized SG2, 0 on native crops. Dropped; the spatial branch reads the same signal.
0.923 vs 0.964 with plain labels. Teacher labelled clean images while the student saw augmented ones — an inconsistent target.
4× fewer MACs, half the CPU latency, 2.8× less batched memory, for −0.001 AUC and 13× more epochs to converge. Reported as the cheap variant.
First reported as 1,301 MB: the counter was reset before cuDNN's autotune, so it recorded the largest algorithm trial. Corrected to 171 MB; both numbers kept.
TensorFlow's CPU path gave MobileNet 18.7 ms; TFLite gives it 1.30. The column measured the runtime. Re-labelled; the GPU ranking is unaffected.

figures.caption: Validation AUC per epoch: the resize pipeline plateaus at 0.96; native crops pass 0.99 within ten epochs; the stride-2 stem takes ~130.
